name: summarization
description: Tests context retention and token efficiency with/without rolling summarization
judgePrompt: Rate each response on quality and relevance (1-10). Pay special attention to whether the response correctly uses context from earlier in the conversation.
messages: My name is Nikita. I'm building a TypeScript CLI agent that streams LLM responses.
The agent supports multiple providers: DeepSeek, Gemini, and LM Studio.
What are the main differences between streaming with SSE vs the Gemini SDK?
I've also added rolling summarization — older messages get compressed into a summary. What do you think of this approach?
What are potential failure modes of LLM-based summarization?
How would you test whether summarization actually preserves important context?
What's a good strategy for choosing SUMMARY_BATCH_SIZE and SUMMARY_TAIL values?
Should the summarization prompt be in English even if the conversation is in Russian?
What other context management strategies exist besides summarization?
If I wanted to add tool use (function calling) to the agent, where would I start?
What is my name, and what project am I working on?
